accepted_statement: For every closed oriented surface S of genus at least 2, there exists a projective (1-)Anosov representation of pi_1(S) into PGL(4, R) whose limit set is a rectifiable embedded circle and is not a C1 embedded submanifold. Consequently it is not C^{1,alpha} for any alpha > 0.
target: Tengren Zhang, Problem 10, Oberwolfach Reports 40/2018, printed p. 2527 / PDF p. 53.
scope_limits: Existence in dimension 4 answers the literal printed question; no assertion for every dimension.
The image preserves a form of signature (2,2); no full-PGL Zariski-density or higher-root Anosov assertion.
Regularity refers to an embedded submanifold, not merely to a chosen parametrization.
The length bound 2 pi uses the round quotient metric specified in PROOF.md.
prior_literature: Pozzetti, Sambarino, and Wienhard, Geometry & Topology 27(8) (2023), 3303–3360, DOI 10.2140/gt.2023.27.3303.
Glorieux and Monclair, Mathematical Research Letters 31(2) (2024), 429–439, DOI 10.4310/MRL.241024233904.
